subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should structured-tool runs automatically omit per-tool summaries, expose this only as an experimental opt-in, or retain the current list as model guidance?
rationale: The duplication is source-backed, but choosing between automatic behavior and another supported config surface requires model-reliability and product-policy judgment that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Harness-aware omission
options.body: Automatically omit per-tool summaries only when the active runtime confirms equivalent structured definitions are delivered, with focused model and context-report tests.

options.title: Experimental config option
options.body: Add a scoped experimental agent setting so operators can measure savings and regressions before any stable default is chosen.

options.title: Retain current guidance
options.body: Keep the list because concise natural-language summaries are considered materially useful across supported models despite the token duplication.

recommendation.title: Harness-aware omission
recommendation.body: Automatically omit per-tool summaries only when the active runtime confirms equivalent structured definitions are delivered, with focused model and context-report tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of prompt assembly, prompt-cache behavior, and its tests and documentation.
